title: 06. College: Ladders & Nets (20k–16k)
description: Read multi-move zigzag chases (Shicho) and loose surrounding nets (Geta) that trap cutting stones cleanly.

puzzles.title: The Loose Net (Geta)
puzzles.concept: When a direct Atari lets the enemy stone push out into open space, step back one knight's-move diagonal (a Net) to block both escape lanes at once.
puzzles.prompt: White's cutting stone at E5 has 3 liberties (E6, F5, E4). Don't push it from behind—cast a loose net to trap it!

solutions.feedback: Textbook Net (Geta)! F6 hovers one diagonal step ahead—whether White pushes to E6 or F5, your surrounding stones cut off every exit.

wrongHints.E6: Direct Atari at E6 lets White extend to F5 and break straight through your stones!
wrongHints.F5: Direct Atari at F5 lets White extend upward to E6 into open territory!
wrongHints.default: Avoid touching E5 directly—step to F6 to form a loose net covering both E6 and F5.

puzzles.title: 2-Step Ladder (Shicho) to the Edge
puzzles.concept: A Ladder (Shicho) keeps the enemy group permanently at 1 liberty in a diagonal staircase until it hits the edge of the board.
puzzles.prompt: White's stone at D6 has 2 liberties (D7 and E6). Start a diagonal ladder driving White toward the top edge!

steps.feedback: Step 1 complete! E6 forces White upward to D7 (2 liberties left: C7 and E7). Keep the staircase tight!
Step 2 complete! C7 drives White onto E7 where the 8th/9th-line top edge crushes its remaining liberties.

wrongHints.D7: Playing D7 first lets White escape horizontally to E6 with 3 liberties!
wrongHints.default: Keep White in continuous Atari toward the top edge: play E6 first, then C7 after White extends to D7.

puzzles.title: Snapback Sacrifice
puzzles.concept: Sometimes playing inside an enemy pocket lets them capture 1 stone—only for their own capturing group to drop to 1 liberty so you immediately recapture the whole chain.
puzzles.prompt: White's 3 corner stones (A8, B8, B9) threaten to connect. Sacrifice a single stone to trigger a Snapback recapture!

solutions.feedback: Brilliant! Playing A9 puts White's 3 stones into Atari—even if White captures A9, their 3 stones sit in the corner with 1 liberty at A9 for an instant Snapback!

wrongHints.default: Look at the empty corner point A9—occupying it reduces White's entire 3-stone corner group to 1 liberty.

puzzles.title: 2-Step Throw-In Liberty Squeeze
puzzles.concept: Throwing a sacrifice stone inside an enemy eye forces them to capture and fill their own outside liberty.
puzzles.prompt: White's 3 stones at H1, J1, J2 have 2 liberties (G1 and H2). Reduce their liberties with a Throw-In!

solutions.feedback: Sharp wedge! H2 cuts White's J2 stone off from H1-J1 and puts J2 in immediate Atari against the edge!

wrongHints.default: Play H2 to split White's J2 stone from H1-J1—J2 drops straight to 1 liberty!

puzzles.title: Read the Ladder Breaker!
puzzles.concept: Before starting a diagonal ladder, look ahead along its path—if an enemy stone sits in the ladder's path, the ladder will fail and you must use a Net instead.
puzzles.prompt: White's stone at D4 has 2 liberties (E4 and D5), and White already has a stone waiting at G7 along the diagonal! Don't play a broken ladder—cast a Net!

solutions.feedback: Great reading! Because White's G7 stone breaks the ladder, stepping to E5 casts a loose Net that traps D4 cleanly!

wrongHints.E4: If you Atari at E4, White runs diagonally (D5-E5-E6-F6) right into their G7 ally and breaks your whole position!
wrongHints.D5: If you Atari at D5, White runs into G7 and escapes! Use a loose Net at E5 instead.
wrongHints.default: White's G7 stone breaks the diagonal ladder—play E5 to trap D4 in a loose Net.

puzzles.title: Edge Pin (Get-a-Base Trap)
puzzles.concept: A stone on the 2nd line flanked on both sides cannot jump over a 3rd-line cap—it has nowhere to make two eyes.
puzzles.prompt: White's stone at E2 is trying to live on the bottom edge between your C2 and G2 stones. Cap it from above!

solutions.feedback: Clean net! F3 teams up with D3, C2, and G2 to seal White's E2 stone completely along the 1st/2nd line.
Strong press! E3 pins White's E2 stone flat onto the 1st line with minimal eye space.

wrongHints.default: Keep White pinned to the bottom edge—play F3 or E3 to close off its escape into the center.

puzzles.title: 3-Step Capturing Race (Semeai) Order
puzzles.concept: When two adjacent enemy groups trap your cutting stones between them, always reduce the liberties of the weaker group first so capturing it gives your stones breathing room to finish the second group.
puzzles.prompt: Your cutting stones (F5, F6, G6) separate White's top-right corner (H8, J7) from White's lower-right chain (H3, H2, J3). Win the capturing race by attacking in the right order!

steps.feedback: Step 1 complete! H4 cuts G4 off from the bottom-right group—White extends to J4. Keep reducing the bottom group's liberties first!
Step 2 complete! H1 removes White's 1st-line base—White connects at J2 with only 1 liberty left. Now finish the bottom group!
Step 3 complete! Capturing the bottom-right chain restores all liberties to your F5-G7 wall, leaving White's top-right corner completely trapped!

wrongHints.H9: Attacking the top-right at H9 first lets White play H4 and capture your F5-G7 cutting stones before you win the race!
wrongHints.J8: Attacking the top-right at J8 first gives White time to play H4 and collapse your center wall! Reduce the bottom-right liberties at H4 first.
wrongHints.default: Win the lower-right capturing race first: play H4 to split White's right side, then H1 and J1.
